text:
jason: Quick sync — Avaros POC asking for a dedicated commit quote. They want a mixed GPU pool (H100 + A100), 3-month POC, and allowed burst up to 5x baseline during end-of-month sims. Need provisional approval for burst discount and a carveout for pre-prod.
ana: Got it. Do we have their baseline vCPU/GPU hours and expected throughput?
jason: Baseline is 40 H100-equivalent hours/day. They expect spikes to ~200 H100-eq hours/day for 6 hours at month end. Rough token estimate ~1.2B tokens/month in POC.
marie: For deal-desk: what's the exact ask? Flat burst discount on the extra capacity, or capped credit? Also need the customer name and bill-to.
jason: Avaros (startup enterprise). Ask: 20% off burst over baseline up to 5x for POC only, and a provisional credit cap of $25k if they exceed. Bill-to: Avaros Inc.
kevin: Quick back-of-envelope on pricing if it helps:
```
# simplified
base_rate = $6.00 per H100-hr
burst_markup = 1.5x
baseline_hours = 40 * 30 = 1,200 hrs
burst_hours = (200-40) * 6 days ~ 960 hrs/month peak (approx)
cost_baseline = 1200 * 6 = $7,200
cost_burst = 960 * 6 * 1.5 = $8,640
proposed_burst_discount = 20% -> savings ~ $1,728
provisional_credit_requested = $25,000
```
kevin: These are coarse numbers but show POC is small relative to cap.
sam: Would we need a mixed-price adjustment for A100 vs H100? A100 ~0.7x H100 cost. If pool is mixed, we should specify a weighted rate or a H100-equivalent pricing clause.
marie: Agreed. Deal-desk note: include weighted-equivalent clause. Also need security checkbox: are they sending any sensitive customer data during POC? If yes, Private deployment or VPC required.
jason: They said synthetic + customer anonymized logs for evaluation. They asked to keep it in our hosted but isolated tenant. They also asked about KMS for key rotation.
marie: For hosted: we can allow with SOC2 controls and customer-managed KMS for encryption-at-rest. Legal will need to review the SOW for the PII handling clause. Please flag with legal.
nana: Operational ask: if we approve provisional burst discount, can we enforce automatic throttles once credit cap hits? We should avoid runaway spend.
kevin: Yes — we can configure route policy to auto-throttle to baseline or fall back to A100-only pool once credit cap consumed. Will require ops change and a short config deploy.
marie: Deal-desk preliminary decision: provisional approval for 3-month POC with 20% burst discount up to a $25k credit cap, subject to finance and legal sign-off, and must include weighted-equivalent GPU rate + auto-throttle on cap. Need a succinct approval ticket (one-paragraph) I can sign.
jason: I'll open the approval ticket with details and ping legal/finance. Also will capture the SOW clause and KMS requirement.
deal-desk-bot: To create an approval request, run `/dealdesk request --customer "Avaros Inc" --thread 1918765432 --amount 25000 --terms "3mo POC, 20% burst discount, weighted GPU eq clause, auto-throttle on cap"`
sam: Thanks — tagging infra to prepare the route policy.
marie: One last note — add a clause that burst discount is non-recurring and only applies during the POC window. After POC, regular committed pricing applies.
jason: Will do. I'll post the ticket link once created. :thumbsup:
